decision_cruda.rationale: Radio and CMMS agree on both failures. LH-01 is likely back at 13:30, with a low estimate of 12:30. C512-10 holds only 136 t, and LH-01 can still clear it by 17:00 at 40 t/h, so a loan adds little. E569-12 holds 241 t. LH-04 is likely back at 11:30, and after that it can load only about 182 t by 17:00, so the stope would not finish. LH-08 comes from the infrastructure heading, which costs only 0.5 oz/h, and takes 0.64 h to get there. It would load about 20 t before lunch and cover the repair gap. Este is not truck-limited (33 t/h inflow against 72 t/h truck capacity). That is roughly +6.6 oz, minus about 2 oz of heading cost, for about +4 oz net. I did not take LH-09 because its heading is worth 2 oz/h, and LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 14:00.
